text: The purpose of this report is to obtain City Council approval for the City to move forward on the strategic acquisition of a suitable industrial property (the "Property") for the future site of a new Toronto Transit Commission ("T.T.C.") garage and maintenance facility (the "10th Garage"). The Property is ideally situated and can offer interim T.T.C. uses until such time that a garage on the Property is constructed. Given the parcel size, additional long-term T.T.C. uses could be incorporated during the Property’s redevelopment process. The description of the Property, its suitability and terms and conditions of the acquisition are described in Confidential Attachment 1 to this report. The Property is considered to be a strategic acquisition that aligns with the T.T.C.
